images.madeBy: Claude, Anthropic's AI model, for this bestax port
images.method: Written by hand as SVG markup, from an idea of its own rather than from the image it replaces. No photograph, stock image or other third-party image was used as an input or as a tracing reference.
images.depicts: A building going up at dawn, with a tower crane on the left, scaffolding on the right and a low skyline along the bottom, under a pale sky; the page's full-screen background.
images.replaces: public/media/background.webp, the original's background photo, whose source the original does not record.
